ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: help with the speech

texts.li: {B_nameDef} sat with {A_nameDef} for an hour going over what {A_pronoun} would say at the vote for {OFFICE}, and crossed out the longest part.
{A_nameDef} tried {A_possessive} speech for the vote on {B_nameDef}, twice, and {B_nameDef} told {A_objective} which half to keep.
{B_nameDef} listened to {A_nameDef} practise the speech for {OFFICE} and said it was good, then said it again more slowly so {A_nameDef} would believe it.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: {B_nameDef} helped with the speech for the vote

texts.li: {B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} where the {OFFICE}'s things are kept and what each is for, and left nothing out.
{B_nameDef} walked {A_nameDef} through how the work of the {OFFICE} gets done, the good habits and the bad ones.
{B_nameDef} handed {A_nameDef} what the {OFFICE} needs and explained the rest, though {B_pronoun} didn't sound happy about it.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: a promise remembered

texts.li: {A_nameDef} reminded {B_nameDef} of the promise from the vote, "{PROMISE}", and said it looked like {B_pronoun} meant it.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} that the promise {B_pronoun} made as {OFFICE} is going well, and that people have noticed.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: {A_nameDef} said the promise was going well

texts.li: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef}, in front of others, what had become of "{PROMISE}".
{A_nameDef} reminded {B_nameDef} of the promise from the vote and said it didn't look much like it was being kept.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued over who should be {OFFICE}: {A_nameDef} for {CANDIDATE}, {B_nameDef} for {RIVAL}.
{A_nameDef} said {CANDIDATE} was the obvious choice for {OFFICE}, and {B_nameDef}, who backs {RIVAL}, did not take it well.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: a petition talked over

texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef}, who both asked the council for {WISH}, went over what they would say if the council asked them why.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about {WISH}, which they both asked for, and agreed it would be worth the wait.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: they talked over the petition for {WISH}

texts.li: {A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} aside and told {B_objective} what {A_pronoun} had learned about being trusted with a seat, and what {A_pronoun} would do differently.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef}, who is young for the {OFFICE}, not to try to please everyone at once.
{A_nameDef} gave {B_nameDef} a piece of advice about the {OFFICE}, and {B_nameDef} wrote it down.
